title: Joint Bayesian Learning of Related Clinical Studies
text:
Project period: 1 April 2025 – 31 March 2027


Project activities
The project develops Bayesian nonparametric methods for the joint analysis of related clinical studies, with the aim of learning from data when and how information should be shared across clinical trials and stages of dynamic treatment regimes.
Project members

Bernardo Nipoti — Principal Investigator, Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca
Matteo Borrotti — Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca
Francesco Barile — Post-doctoral researcher, Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca
Francesco Claudio Stingo — Coordinator of the partner unit, Università degli Studi di Firenze
Giovanni Poli — Post-doctoral researcher, Università degli Studi di Firenze
